jobs.title: Responsable senior de projets numériques et IA / Senior Digital & AI Project Leader
jobs.description:
Job Description

Responsable senior de projets numériques et IA / Senior Digital & AI Project Leader

English job description follows***

Description De L'emploi

Vous avez une solide expérience en gestion de projets complexes, vous avez travaillé dans le domaine numérique et la transformation par l'IA et vous souhaitez évoluer et développer de nouvelles compétences? Ce poste est pour vous!

Le programme d'avions commerciaux A220 recherche un Responsable de projets numériques et IA
pour rejoindre notre équipe Solutions Numériques (ABSD) basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec les équipes Business et IM basées à Mirabel et Toulouse.

Vous Ferez Partie De L'équipe De Gestion De Projet De Solutions Numériques Des Services à La Clientèle, Chargée De Diriger Des Projets Pour Un Ensemble Complet De Produits Et Services Numériques Couvrant

Des solutions numériques et d’IA pour l'ensemble de l'organisation des services à la clientèle
Services digitaux eSolutions directement déployés auprès de nos Clients (Compagnies Aériennes)

L'organisation de l'équipe est établie pour promouvoir la collaboration croisée de manière autonome, en se soutenant mutuellement et en apprenant collectivement.

Votre rôle en tant que Responsable de projets numériques et IA
sera de définir et diriger la feuille de route stratégique de transformation numérique et d'IA, tout en assurant la livraison du portefeuille de projets complexes.

Votre Environnement De Travail

Le siège du programme d'avions commerciaux A220 est situé à Mirabel, dans la région métropolitaine de Montréal, à deux pas de la ville dynamique de Montréal. Réputée pour son environnement paisible et sûr, la région offre une grande qualité de vie aux jeunes professionnels ou aux professionnels expérimentés, ainsi qu'aux familles, en équilibrant parfaitement les opportunités de carrière et les activités de plein air, ce qui en fait un endroit vraiment spécial où il fait bon vivre.

Parce Que Nous Prenons Soin De Vous

Avantages financiers: Salaire attractif, bonus annuel, régime d’assurances collectives, régime de retraite et régime d’achat d’actions.
Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle: Une politique de travail hybride, une cafétéria sur site, une politique de congés très concurrentielle.
Bien-être / santé: Programme d’Aide aux Employé.e.s (PAE), programme de rabais, service médical sur site, service de navette gratuite entre Montréal et Mirabel et application de covoiturage.
Développement individuel: des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, mobilité nationale et internationale).

Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation.

Vos Défis

Définir et piloter la feuille de route stratégique de transformation numérique et d'IA alignée sur les objectifs globaux des Services Clientèle;
Cadrer, évaluer et déployer des solutions basées sur l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, prédictive et automatisation) dans les processus métiers et produits clients;
Diriger la livraison de portefeuilles de projets complexes (CapEx/OpEx) dans le respect des délais, des budgets et des standards de qualité (Digital Gates)`;
Superviser les budgets des projets et établir des cadres d'évaluation de la valeur ajoutée et du retour sur investissement (ROI);
Piloter la stratégie globale de gestion du changement pour garantir l'adoption optimale des nouvelles technologies par les équipes internes et les clients;
Assurer l'alignement stratégique et la coordination transversale entre les parties prenantes Métier et IM réparties entre Mirabel et Toulouse.;
Gérer les relations stratégiques avec les fournisseurs externes, la négociation des mandats et le suivi des engagements contractuels;
Identifier et atténuer proactivement les risques liés aux projets, à la cybersécurité, à la protection des données et à la conformité de l'IA.

Votre Profil

Diplôme universitaire pertinent en ingénierie, informatique, gestion des systèmes d'information, administration des affaires ou dans une discipline connexe;
Minimum de dix (10) ans d'expérience en gestion de projets numériques et en conduite de transformations organisationnelles d'envergure à l'échelle de l'entreprise;
Expérience avérée dans l'intégration opérationnelle de solutions numériques avancées et de technologies basées sur l'intelligence artificielle;
Solide expertise en gestion des parties prenantes et capacité à influencer et aligner des équipes décisionnelles dans un environnement matriciel international;
Maîtrise éprouvée des méthodologies structurées de gestion du changement et de conduite de l'adoption par les utilisateurs;
Excellentes capacités d'analyse, d'arbitrage stratégique et d'évaluation financière de projets;
Niveau avancé en français et en anglais (oral et écrit).

En raison du secteur d’activité (aéronautique), de multiples contacts avec des entités Airbus situées dans le monde entier, et d’interactions avec les fournisseurs et clients également situés dans le monde entier, la connaissance de l’anglais est demandée dans ce poste.

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en soumettant votre candidature en ligne maintenant !

Job Description

Do you have solid experience in managing complex projects, have you worked in the digital and AI transformation domain and would you like to progress and develop new skills? Then this job is for you!

The A220 commercial aircraft program is looking for a Senior Digital & AI Project Leader
to join our Digital Solutions team based in Mirabel (Québec, Canada), where you will work jointly with the Business & IM teams based in Mirabel and Toulouse.

Responsibilities

You will be part of the Customer Services Digital Solutions Project Management team responsible for leading projects for a full set of digital products and services covering:

Digital and AI solutions for the full range of Customer Services organization
eSolutions digital services directly deployed to our Customers (Airlines)

The team organization is established to promote cross-collaboration autonomously, supporting each other and learning collectively.

Your role as Senior Digital and AI Project Leader
will be to define and lead the strategic digital and AI transformation roadmap while driving the delivery of complex project portfolios.

Your Working Environment

The A220 commercial aircraft Programme is headquartered in Mirabel, in the greater Montreal area, where the vibrant city of Montreal is just a stone’s throw away. Known for its peaceful and safe environment, the region offers a high quality of life for younger or experienced professionals and families, perfectly balancing career opportunities and outdoor activities that makes it a truly special place to call home.

How We Care For You

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, annual bonus, group insurance plan, pension plan and share purchase plan.
Work / Life Balance: A hybrid working policy, on-site cafeterias and a highly competitive holiday policy.
Wellbeing/Health: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Discount Program, on-site Medical Service, free shuttle service between Montreal and Mirabel and carpooling application.
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility.

Your Challenges

Define and lead the strategic digital and AI transformation roadmap aligned with overarching Customer Services goals;
Evaluate, frame, and deploy artificial intelligence solutions (generative, predictive AI, and automation) within business workflows and customer platforms;
Drive the delivery of complex project portfolios (CapEx/OpEx) ensuring alignment with time, budget, and quality standards (Digital Gates);
Oversee project budgets and establish frameworks to measure business value and return on investment (ROI);
Lead overarching organizational change management strategies to ensure high adoption of new tools across internal teams and airline clients;
Ensure strategic alignment and cross-functional coordination between Business and IM stakeholders across Mirabel and Toulouse;
Manage strategic third-party vendor relationships, statement of work negotiation, and contract delivery performance;
Proactively identify and mitigate project risks, cybersecurity requirements, data privacy, and AI compliance standards.

Your Boarding Pass

Relevant university degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline;
Minimum ten (10) years of experience managing digital projects and orchestrating large-scale, enterprise-level organizational transformations;
Proven track record in the operational integration of advanced digital solutions and artificial intelligence technologies;
Strong stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence and align decision-making teams in a global matrix organization;
Proven proficiency in structured change management methodologies and driving user adoption;
Strong analytical skills, strategic decision-making ability, and financial project evaluation expertise;
Advanced language skills in both French and English (spoken and written).

This role may involve some travels for business (worldwide).

Due to the sector of activity (aerospace), frequent contacts with Airbus entities worldwide, and interactions with suppliers and clients also located across the globe, proficiency in English is required for this position.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply now!

jobs.title: Leader, Strategic Transformation (Workday and Business Transformation)
jobs.description:
Salary

The salary range for this position is CAD $55.25 - $79.42 / hour

Job Summary

Lead Business Transformation and Shape the Future of Healthcare!

Are you a dynamic and strategic leader with a passion for making a positive impact in healthcare? Do you find fulfillment in bringing corporate and clinical partners together to redesign business processes, enable new ways of working, and translate technology investments into meaningful system improvements? If so, we have an incredible opportunity for you to be part of a well-established team and take the lead on enterprise changes that will shape the future of healthcare!

The Opportunity

Bring your initiative, client service focus, systems level thinking and leadership skills to our dynamic team of seasoned project and change professionals. This Leader role is aligned to the Employee Experience portfolio, partnering on people and business-focused transformation priorities across the region. You will support a program of integrated initiatives in the People and Financial Stewardship pillars, partnering strategically on Fraser Health Workday implementation and enterprise changes to improve provider experience and organizational performance.

As Leader within the Strategic Transformation Team, you will lead members of our internal consulting team (senior consultants and coordinators), and partner with executive sponsors (vice-presidents, executive directors, directors and/or medical leaders) across the region to ensure plans for Fraser Health’s highest priority, cross-organizational change initiatives, are successfully designed, implemented, integrated and evaluated. Working with sponsors and operational partners, you will help define success, connect interdependent initiatives, and evaluate the outcomes and business benefits.

What You’ll Do

Our Leaders support diverse portfolios, leading alongside clinical and corporate sponsors to ensure collaboration between cross-functional teams, bringing cutting edge ideas to the table and helping to break down silos. You will help partners translate strategic priorities into an integrated transformation roadmap, understand current-state challenges, and design and implement future-state business processes. Bringing project delivery and change management together, you will connect implementation planning with operational readiness, adoption and sustainment of benefits. Your work will contribute to the improvement of healthcare processes, enhance the quality of patient care, and will make a meaningful difference in the lives of the individuals and communities that Fraser Health serves. Your expertise in leading teams, along with proven, applied skills in project and change management will be the driving force behind transformative initiatives that directly impact patient outcomes and organizational success.

Who We Are: The Strategic Transformation and Project Delivery Team

The Fraser Health Planning & Transformation department values a culture of openness, partnership, creativity and innovation where we recognize each other’s expertise, honour the contributions of everyone and have each other’s back. Your ideas will be welcomed as we collectively strive to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We provide ongoing professional development opportunities and a vibrant and inclusive work environment that supports flexibility and hybrid work models.

The Ideal Candidate For This Role Will

Have an in-depth understanding of the health care system and Fraser Health at both strategic and operational levels. Experience of business transformation, and knowledge of Workday in healthcare considered an asset.
Bring a business transformation lens to project delivery: You've successfully led a complex portfolio of inter-related projects from initiation to completion, demonstrating a keen ability to navigate challenges and deliver exceptional results. You connect delivery milestones with strategic outcomes, manage dependencies and help partners assess whether changes achieve their intended benefits.
Be a change management champion: You have an intentional approach to engage people to move from awareness of a change to adopting and sustaining new ways of working.
Have a passion for healthcare: Your insights will drive projects that directly impact patient care and organizational success. Experience in a large health organization would be beneficial.
Have a collaborative spirit: We believe in the power of teamwork. Your ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and impacted parties is essential for success in this role.
Have a Master’s degree in health administration or a related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses: PMP and Prosci(R) or other certification/designation in leadership, project and change management would be an asset.
Have ten (10) years’ recent, related experience in an environment focused on delivering change/transformation initiatives using project and change management methods in a large, complex environment, including supervision of others.
Have access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Valued Benefits

Joining our team offers you opportunities to work in a rapidly growing organization, with health professionals who are excellent in their respective fields, career growth and advancement, a competitive compensation package (including four weeks of vacation to start, comprehensive health benefits, and pension plan), and the rewarding opportunity to make a difference every single day in health care.

Detailed Overview

The Leader, Strategic Transformation is the principal agent for change who seeks to shift or transition a major part of the Organization from a current state to a desired future state. The Leader ensures that the plans and goals of the executive sponsor are successfully designed, implemented, integrated and evaluated as they relate to the requested redesign, restructure and reconfiguration of their service area. Where applicable, the Leader may provide subject matter expertise during the client's planning process. The Leader oversees and manages the budget specified for the change process and is required to assemble, direct and supervise a team of Senior Consultants that will ensure the Leader's blueprint for change is done effectively, efficiently, on time and on budget.

Responsibilities

Leads multi-stakeholder, organization-wide strategic initiatives from current state to the desired future state through idea generation, planning, design, implementation and evaluation; provides subject matter expertise and leadership on the strategic initiative to the executive sponsors or sponsor group (e.g., steering committees) throughout the change initiative.
Manages the overall coordination of strategic initiatives from a strategic change context; develops, oversees and manages the overall transformation plan on behalf of the sponsors; where appropriate, co-manages non-Strategic Transformation Team project resources working collaboratively with other support groups in the organization that are critical for the successful execution of the change.
Participates in the recruitment of staff and manages the professional development of employees through the formal assessment of training needs and the development of training plans: responsible to oversee and as required, participate in the management of human resource matters; prepares and conducts performance assessments for the Senior Consultants, Strategic Transformation.
Provides work direction and leadership to a team of Senior Consultants, Strategic Transformation throughout the initiative(s) assigned to them and ensures strategic transformation resource needs are assigned appropriately; secures and manages contractual relationships with external consultants, as needed.
Identifies and manages resources and budgets required to complete strategic transformation work; develops a budget report and schedule for monitoring expenditures and variance analysis of all assigned aspects of the initiative and reports regularly to the sponsor(s).
Identifies and manages key stakeholder strategies and works collaboratively with Communications to develop appropriate communication strategies.
Applies project and change management principles to develop engagement strategies and action plans to maximize likelihood of success; working collaboratively with Organizational Development as required.
Identifies, establishes, and oversees the appropriate team structure and membership required for the strategic transformation initiative(s) including sponsorship, champion, steering committee and delivery/implementation teams, as well as, FH and external resources.
Assesses the impact of strategic transformation initiatives from a systems perspective and manages the impacts and interdependencies with other initiatives happening in FH; supports the Director, Strategic Transformation in the STT prioritization process with the Executive Team.
Develops and/or oversees the development of relevant documentation (e.g., statements of work, proposals, charters, work plans, risk management plans, and change management plans,, etc.); working collaboratively with Health and Business Analytics and other departments on developing effective measurement systems to track progress towards achievement of results/outcomes.
Partners with other departments in the development, maintenance and promotion of the organization's repeatable and sustainable initiative, project, and change management processes.
Participates in the evaluation and refinement of tools and methods utilized by the Strategic Transformation Team, as required; champions the various STT methodologies; assists in the development and presentation of initiative, project, and change management coaching, mentoring and instruction strategies and materials.

Qualifications

Education and Experience

Master's degree in Health Administration or related discipline supplemented with project and change management courses. Ten (10) years' experience including five (5) years in a project management role and the supervision of others, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Valid BC Driver's Licence and access to a vehicle for business related purposes.

Competencies

Demonstrates the leadership practices of the Fraser Health Leadership Framework of Clear, Caring and Courageous and creates the conditions for people to succeed.

Professional/Technical Capabilities

Expert knowledge of change and project management principles coupled with an indepth understanding of the healthcare system at both the strategic and operational levels.
Knowledge of other health care disciplines and their role in health care.
Ability to operate a PC and effectively utilize a variety of software applications to support the initiative management activities.
Physical ability to perform the duties of the position.

About Fraser Health

Fraser Health is the heart of health care for over two million people in Metro Vancouver and the Fraser Valley in British Columbia, Canada, on the traditional, ancestral and unceded lands of the Coast Salish and Nlaka’pamux Nations and is home to 32 First Nations within the Fraser Salish region.

People - those we care for and those who care for them - are at the heart of everything we do. Our hospital and community-based services are delivered by a team of 50,000+ staff, medical staff and volunteers.

We are committed to planetary health and value diversity in the work force. We strive to maintain an environment of respect, caring and trust. Fraser Health’s hiring practices aspire to ensure all individuals are treated in an inclusive, equitable and culturally safe manner.

Together, we are the heart of health care.

jobs.title: Director Technology Transformation Stores
jobs.description:
Embark on a rewarding career with Sobeys Inc., celebrated among Canada’s Top 100 employers where your unique contributions drive success.

Sobeys is full of exciting opportunities and we are always looking for bright new talent to join our team! We currently have a full-time opportunity for a Director Technology Transformation Stores Team. This role can be based out of one our main offices including: Stellarton, NS; Mississauga, ON; Montreal; QC.

As a Director Technology Transformation Stores with Sobeys, you will:

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, target-state architecture, and execution roadmap for the Next Gen POS program, taking a strong lens to how the technology enables long-term enterprise strategic initiatives
Build, lead, and develop the dedicated internal technology delivery organization while defining the need for external partners and managing them through delivery
Establish and operate a disciplined technology delivery model, tightly integrated with the overall POS program governance, planning, and execution cadence to ensure delivery on time, within budget, with a solution that is operationally resilient and secure to achieve expected business benefits
Partner with business teams (operations, merchandising, marketing, etc.) to shape requirements and outcomes, while constructively challenging assumptions and applying a future-state technology lens
Orchestrate end-to-end technology delivery across POS solution, integrations, testing, security, infrastructure, and other upstream / downstream systems, ensuring a cohesive, scalable, and future proof solution that meets business needs
Own vendor strategy and performance management across the POS and payments ecosystem, including delivery accountability and dependency management
Drive executive-level decision making and communication, proactively surfacing technology risks, options, and trade-offs across scope, cost, timeline, and operational impact to maintain momentum and alignment
Drive continuous enhancement of Electronic Shelf Label technology, in line with business goals and expectations
Drive end-to-end technology delivery and roll out of the Merchant Acquirer transition, including vendor coordination, implementation planning, financial trade-offs, and delivery against committed timelines
Manage day-to-day operations, enhancement, and stability of existing core store systems (including POS, payments, ESLs, etc)

Your Experience And Resume Will Show Us

Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, related degree, or relevant experience in Technology.
10+ years of relevant professional work experience, including 5+ years progressive experience in Information Technology and 3+ years of people leadership experience.
Proven success overseeing large-scale technical implementations and/or major business transformations enabled by technology, delivered on time, within approved budget, and to expected level of quality.
Experience in product management, working with complex vendors, and system integrations
Sound organizational, analytical, judgment and decision-making skills with proven abilities in problem-solving complex issues.
Proven ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
Able to motivate team members and know how to efficiently make important decisions.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience in retail and store system modernization is an asset.
Industry knowledge and technical expertise; knowledgeable on product life cycle and SDLC; Familiar with Project Management, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, etc. methodologies.
Prioritization skills, with demonstrated experience executing tasks in a high-pressure environment.
Model a continuous improvement mindset, challenge the status quo by identifying opportunities to make things better.

Who We Are

Sobeys is one of Canada’s leading grocery retailers, with more than 1,600 stores across all 10 provinces and banners including Sobeys, Safeway, IGA, Foodland, FreshCo, Thrifty Foods, and Lawtons Drug Stores. Our 128,000 teammates and franchise affiliates are passionate about delivering great food and exceptional experiences to our customers and communities.

Learn More About Our Story And Culture

Who We Are | Why Work With Us

Total Rewards

We offer a Total Rewards package designed to support teammates at work and in life. Depending on role and eligibility, teammates may receive health and dental benefits, retirement and savings programs including an Employee Share Ownership Plan, a 10% in-store discount at participating banners, virtual healthcare and an Employee and Family Assistance Program, learning and development opportunities, parental leave top-up, and paid vacation.

Sobeys is committed to providing a compensation structure that is flexible, equitable and competitive in the market to enable performance and growth. To learn more about this opportunity including the expected range of compensation in accordance with Pay Transparency Legislation where required please click the “I’m interested” or "Apply" button above. Individual compensation is determined based on qualifications, experience, and internal equity within the range provided.

Additional Information

External websites may share our organization's job postings which includes compensation information based on similar roles and market benchmarks. These figures are provided for general comparison purposes only and are not issued or verified by our organization.

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to support efficiencies in the candidate screening, assessment, and recruitment processes. These AI tools do not make hiring decisions on behalf of the Company. Hiring decisions are made by our Hiring Teams.

Sobeys is committed to creating accessible and inclusive hiring processes. We will work with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process.

Please note: Successful candidates will be required to provide documentation to prove their legal ability to work in the position during the onboarding process. Documentation will be assessed by the employer prior to commencement of work.

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible
